review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role focuses on validating functional and non-functional requirements, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with development, product, and business teams to deliver stable, reliable releases. Key Responsibilities Test Design & Execution Analyze business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to design detailed test cases and test data. Collaboration Work closely with developers and Product Owners to clarify requirements and expected behavior. Adapt to the domain and requirements of each assigned project. Requirements — Must Have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 2–4 years of hands-on experience in software testing / quality control. Requirements — Nice to Have Hands-on exposure to test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, REST Assured, K6).
